scripts.dev: concurrently -n ADMIN,CLIENT,SERVER -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix admin" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix admin && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix admin && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix admin && npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix admin && npm run test --prefix client && npm run test --prefix server
